in_sanskrit.name: सरज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules, governs, presides, is the queen or the lady, the mistress or the goddess.

in_hindi.name: सरज
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who fulfills all purposes, the doer of all things.

in_tamil.name: சரஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is like a village, the one who is like a man, the great one.

in_telugu.name: శరజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the refuge, the one who is the god of refuge.

in_marathi.name: Saraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'saras' meaning 'lake' or 'pool', and 'j' derived from the Sanskrit word 'jala' meaning 'water'. The name Saraj thus means 'Lotus Lake'.
